Apple TV today released a trailer for the second season of the German dark comedy "Where's Wanda?", which will return to the platform on October 21. Check out the trailer below.

"Where's Wanda?" returns on October 21

Nearly two years ago, "Where's Wanda?" premiered on Apple TV, following the Klatt family as they searched for their missing daughter, Wanda, who is also the show's protagonist.

After police efforts to find her proved fruitless and increasingly frustrating, the Klatts decided to investigate on their own, uncovering dark secrets about their neighbours along the way.

The first season of "Where's Wanda?" ran for a total of eight episodes. The series returns on October 21 with another eight-episode season, with new episodes premiering every Wednesday from now until December 9.
